channel.title: The Asian Age - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Asian Age (asianage.com)

item.title: OF CABBAGES AND KINGS | Of The Nigerian Lottery & Other Scams On Web To Clean You Out | Farrukh Dhondy
item.description: Tir’s investigation began with an interview with the parents of a blackmailed young man who had taken his own life. She then very bravely went to speak to the blackmailing “sexploiters” in the slums of Nigeria

item.title: Dev 360 | Reasons For Despair & Reasons For Hope | Patralekha Chatterjee
item.description: At school, children are told to celebrate India’s diversity. On the street, diversity is butchered with monotonous regularity

item.title: AA Edit | Real Challenge Begins For Mamdani
item.description: A social media campaign full of empathy caught the attention of people across the spectrum as Mr Mamdani spoke words like “affordability”, made promises that were sweet to the ear of lesser earners like lower rents in the Big Apple, making free creche care available and cheaper connectivity to all the people

item.title: AA Edit | Big Relief For Vodafone, But Did It Come Too Late?
item.description: Under the telecom policy designed by the Atal Behari Vajpayee government in 1999, companies that won telecom licences were supposed to pay a part of their adjusted gross revenue (AGR) to the government every year in lieu of an upfront payment of licence fees

item.title: Book Review | What It Takes to be Queen of India’s Underworld
item.description: Narrated in a readable style and set in re-imagined scenarios complete with conversations and other details, the book evokes pity, fear and admiration in equal parts

item.title: Book Review | A Politician Who Stands up for Human Rights
item.description: In this book of articles published in various newspapers and the lectures he gave reflects Kumar’s discerning thoughts about judiciary and democracy

item.title: Book Review | Open-Ended Puzzle About Motherhood
item.description: Intense but restrained, this novel will make you think — not just about the plot but quite likely your own life too

item.title: Shashi Warrier | A New Year’s Party That Ended Too Soon
item.description: “We’ve realised the damage a serious general hangover can do on a working day,” said Raghavan, “so now we make it a point to give everyone the day off”

item.title: Anita Katyal | BJP Happy With Rise Of Priyanka? Digvijaya Issues Warning To Cong
item.description: The BJP will obviously be hoping that the “Priyanka lao” demand in the Congress will create confusion in its rank and file and even drive a wedge between Priyanka and Rahul Gandhi

item.title: Pavan K. Varma | After A Year Of Confusion, India Faces Hard Decisions
item.description: The way in which the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise was carried out in Bihar, and now in the whole country, leaves much to be desired
